entities.name: Kjeldoran Frostbeast
entities.description: Elemental beast of ice from Kjeldor that rises from ice into a clawed, toothed humanoid form; dangerous in combat and in proximity.

entities.name: Disa the Restless
entities.description: Wrote in her journal that two of her warriors found the Frostbeast dangerous.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Dominarian home of the Kjeldoran Frostbeast.
